content.title: Colombia vs France Lineups, Live Streams, Cable, How & Where to Watch In the USA
content.text: Colombia and France will play against each other after both nations played a friendly match a few days ago in the United States.The Colombia vs France match will be the last friendly match for both teams this month, with Colombia losing their previous match and France winning their previous match.AdvertisementFrance played against Brazil last Thursday in Foxborough, Massachusetts, at Gillette Stadium. France defeated Brazil 2-1 with goals from Kylian Mbappe, who scored in the first half with a chip goal, and Hugo Ekitike, who scored in the second half.France conceded in the 78th minute of the match from a goal from Gleison Bremer.Colombia lost 2-1 to Croatia last Thursday after taking the lead very early in the first half. In the second minute of the match, Jhon Arias scored the opener for Colombia.AdvertisementJhon Arias of Colombia celebrates scoring his team's first goal with teammates during the international friendly match between Colombia and Croatia at Camping World Stadium on March 26, 2026 in Orlando, Florida. (Photo by Julio Aguilar/Getty Images)Photo by Julio Aguilar/Getty Images (Photo by Julio Aguilar/Getty Images)Croatia equalized through a goal from Luka Vuskovic from outside the box. Just before halftime, Croatia scored their second goal of the night through a goal from Igor Matanovic.Colombia and France last played each other in a friendly match that took place in France on March 23, 2018. Colombia won that match 3-2 with goals from Luis Muriel, Radamel Falcao, and Juan Quintero.Official Lineups for Colombia and FranceColombiaGoalkeeper: Alvaro MonteroDefenders: Johan Mojica, Davinson Sanchez, Juan David Cabal, Daniel MunozMidfielders: Richard Rios, Jefferson Lerma, James RodriguezForwards: Luis Diaz, Luis Suarez, Jhon AriasFranceGoalkeeper: Brice SambaDefenders: Lucas Digne, Lucas Hernandez, Maxence Lacroix, Pierre KaluluMidfielders: Warren Zaïre-Emery, N'Golo Kante, Rayan CherkiForwards: Maghnes Akliouche, Marcus Thuram, Desire DoueColombia vs France will kick off at 3 p.m. ET/ 12 p.m. PT in the United States. The match will kick off at 3 p.m. local time in Landover, Maryland, at the Northwest Stadium.AdvertisementThe match will be available to watch in the United States through select TV channels and streaming services.Telemundo (USA)NBC Universo (USA)ESPN Unlimited (USA)Peacock (USA)This story was originally published by Athlon Sports on Mar 29, 2026, where it first appeared in the Soccer section.
